title: docs: policy.ts hasPassingCheck comment still says the ps1 wrapper records qualityGate verbatim
description:
Found by QA of task-8fc35d31 (completion f1399a3). That card makes scripts/moe-agent.ps1 trim settings.qualityGate where Read-MoeCommitSettings reads it (moe-agent.ps1:1980, `$qg.Trim()`), so both wrappers now run and record the trimmed command. Its approved plan limited it to five script files, so this daemon comment was out of its scope.

packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/policy.ts:170-172 (hasPassingCheck doc comment, from bb5e7e2 / task-808869c5) still justifies the recorded-command trim with: "the ps1 wrapper records settings.qualityGate verbatim (the sh one trims it)". That is now false.

Keep the trim itself. It still protects CheckRun records written by a pre-fix ps1 wrapper and already on disk, an IDE plugin that still bundles the old wrapper, and any direct moe.record_check_run caller (recordCheckRun.ts:63 stores `command` verbatim). Only the stated reason is stale. Comment-only; no behaviour change.
definitionOfDone: packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/policy.ts hasPassingCheck doc comment no longer claims either wrapper records settings.qualityGate verbatim, and names why the recorded-command trim stays (records written before task-8fc35d31, older bundled wrappers, direct record_check_run callers)
The diff changes only that comment (no code); the daemon build (npm run build in packages/moe-daemon) passes

implementationPlan.description:
Replace the stale reason in the hasPassingCheck doc comment. This is a comment-only change.

In packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/policy.ts, find the JSDoc directly above `function hasPassingCheck` (lines 165-174 at planning). Replace exactly these two lines (172-173):
```
 * compare: the ps1 wrapper records settings.qualityGate verbatim (the sh one trims
 * it), and no shell sees the padding a hand-edited project.json can carry.
```
with these five lines:
```
 * compare. Both wrappers trim settings.qualityGate before they run and record it,
 * but a padded command can still reach this compare: a run the ps1 wrapper recorded
 * before task-8fc35d31, a run from an older wrapper an IDE plugin still bundles,
 * or a direct moe.record_check_run call (checkRunStore keeps `command` as sent).
 * Trimming is safe: no shell sees the padding a hand-edited project.json can carry.
```
Leave everything else byte-identical: line 171 (" * `command` is the trimmed setting, and the recorded command is trimmed before the"), the first paragraph, and all code. Both trims stay: `run.command.trim()` in hasPassingCheck and `.trim()` in requiredCheckCommand. They protect the three sources the new text names.

Error handling does not change. The try/catch in hasPassingCheck, which logs a lookup failure and answers false, is untouched, and no new failure path is added.

Every claim in the text was checked against code at planning:
- ps1 trims in Read-MoeCommitSettings at scripts/moe-agent.ps1:2036 (`$qg.Trim()`, from task-8fc35d31 / f1399a3).
- sh strips at scripts/moe-agent.sh:7333 (`v.strip()`).
- state/checkRunStore.ts:106-114 requireCommand stores `command` untrimmed.
- tools/recordCheckRun.ts:63 documents it as never trimmed.

Make the change with the built-in Edit tool, which keeps policy.ts LF (`git ls-files --eol` shows i/lf w/lf). On this box Serena replace_content rewrites the whole file as CRLF (mem:gotcha-serena-edit-rewrites-crlf-on-windows). The new text contains no `*/`, which would close the JSDoc early.

Out of scope: src/tools/qaApprove.test.ts:1451-1454 and src/state/deliveryProjection.test.ts:232 carry the same stale wording, but DoD 2 limits this diff to this one comment. They are filed as BACKLOG follow-up task-6177c9c4711542509512fa96cfee8b50. Do not touch them.

implementationPlan.description:
Prove the diff is comment-only and that `npm run build` passes, without touching the shared checkout.

(a) Shared checkout, from the repo root:
- `git diff --numstat -- packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/policy.ts` prints `5	2`.
- `git diff` of that file shows only ` *` JSDoc lines.
- `git ls-files --eol` still shows w/lf.

(b) Run `npm run build` in a scratch export of HEAD plus this one file, NEVER in the shared checkout. Three reasons:
- Its prebuild regenerates src/generated/initFiles.ts from docs/roles/*.md. Peers' uncommitted docs/roles/*.reference.md lines (the ponytail rows; verified absent from initFiles.ts) would dirty the clean initFiles.ts, and the post-flight could land that file in this task as MEASURED.
- `clean` deletes the dist a live daemon may run from.
- tsc would compile peers' dirty src.

Run the git lines in ONE Bash call from the repo root (env does not persist between tool calls):
```
N=t42c1-$RANDOM; S=/d/moe-scratch/$N; mkdir -p "$S"; echo "$N"
export GIT_INDEX_FILE=D:/moe-scratch/$N.index
git read-tree HEAD && git update-index -- packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/policy.ts && T=$(git write-tree)
unset GIT_INDEX_FILE
git diff --stat HEAD "$T"   # must list ONLY packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/policy.ts
git archive "$T" packages/moe-daemon docs | tar -x -C "$S"
```
Then link node_modules and build:
1. PowerShell: `New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path D:\moe-scratch\<N>\packages\moe-daemon\node_modules -Target D:\projexts\moes\packages\moe-daemon\node_modules`.
2. Bash: `cd /d/moe-scratch/<N>/packages/moe-daemon && npm run build; echo exit=$?`. It must print exit=0.

Tear down in this order (mem:gotcha-qa-scratch-and-snapshot-traps section 2):
1. PowerShell: `$j = Get-Item -Force <junction>; if ($j.LinkType -eq 'Junction') { [System.IO.Directory]::Delete($j.FullName, $false) }`.
2. `Test-Path D:\projexts\moes\packages\moe-daemon\node_modules\typescript\package.json` must print True.
3. Only then, Bash: `rm -rf /d/moe-scratch/<N> /d/moe-scratch/<N>.index`.

(c) Final self-check:
- Re-read the new comment against the four code facts in step 1.
- `git status --porcelain -- packages/moe-daemon/src/generated` must match the pre-task state. initFiles.ts stays clean. skillFiles.ts is a peer's pre-existing M: leave it alone.

Then call complete_task:
- modifiedFiles: packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/policy.ts only.
- verification: { command: 'npm run build', exitCode: 0 }, with an outputTail that says it ran in a scratch export of HEAD + policy.ts and quotes the numstat.

(b) Scratch build, following the plan's recipe: temp index D:/moe-scratch/t42c1-6882.index, `git read-tree HEAD` + `update-index policy.ts`, write-tree T=61450b423303bc2508fc706a9069eb75baa3185e. `git diff --stat HEAD T` listed ONLY packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/policy.ts (5 insertions, 2 deletions). `git archive T packages/moe-daemon docs` went to D:/moe-scratch/t42c1-6882, with a junction to the live node_modules. `npm run build` there ran clean, generate-init-files ("8 role docs + 3 subagents"), generate-skill-files ("62 skill files across 15 skills") and tsc, and printed exit=0. dist/delivery/policy.js carries the new text. Teardown: junction unlinked via [System.IO.Directory]::Delete (LinkType Junction checked first); live node_modules/typescript/package.json = True; 0 reparse points left; then rm -rf of the scratch dir, index and log (no leftovers). (c) Self-check: every claim was re-verified against code. ps1 trims at moe-agent.ps1:2036, runs that value (3886 -> 3806 via ComSpec) and records it (1416 $Gate.Command). sh strips at moe-agent.sh:7333, runs `bash -c "$QUALITY_GATE"` (3963) and records the same value (1996). checkRunStore.ts:106-114 requireCommand returns `command` untrimmed. recordCheckRun.ts:63 says "never trimmed". `git status --porcelain -- packages/moe-daemon/src/generated` matches the pre-task state: only the peer's pre-existing ` M skillFiles.ts`, initFiles.ts clean. Live packages/moe-daemon/dist untouched (no build ran in the shared checkout). Considered but theoretical only: the kept clause "no shell sees the padding" is literally true for current wrappers, which trim before they run. For a record from a pre-fix wrapper the padding is leading/trailing whitespace that cmd /c and bash -c ignore, so the trim-for-compare still equates only equivalent commands.
